text_block_list.text:
And so, on the day of the URA award
ceremony...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This is where the map says. Hmm... It
does have a
certain sense of formality
about it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
It turns out the award ceremony is in a
different
venue this year, where even the
entrance has a
very solemn air.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Heh, guess it was worth coming early.
Look over
there, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
We can see them with our own eyes...
The alpha
predators.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Мэдзиро МакКуин and Михоно Бурбон.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин is known by all to be
the
greatest stayer. She successfully won
the spring
Tenno Sho where the best
long-distance racer is
decided.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And then there's Михоно Бурбон, who
forged
her physique and stamina into a
fine-tuned
machine. She has also been
Umamusume of the
Year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: And over there, there's Огури Кэп and...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Огури Кэп emerged from regional races
and
swept the nationals. It's safe to say
that her
popularity and strength
together make her a top
racer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Симболи Рудольф.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Ah, it appears some of the invitees are
here in
recognition for previous efforts,
not only for
prizes.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Sis...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I spied the star of the day so I
thought I
would come and say hello.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The dress code this year is signature
racewear,
apparently chosen in honor of
you. They are
clothes for a racer, after
all, which means—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
That's enough. I don't want to get a big
head.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Why are you talking about big heads?!
My head
isn't big!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I wasn't talking about you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...In any case, let's hurry inside.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Have you prepared a speech for when
you accept
your award?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: ...Speech?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Tell me you aren't serious!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list:
As long as you answer their questions honestly,
you'll be just fine!

text_block_list.text: I see.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Does she really, though?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And without further ado, please
welcome the
Umamusume of the Year,
Нарита Брайан! Please
come to the stage!
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text: Ooohhh!
text_block_list.name: Audience

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан is so hot right now! If she
keeps this
up, do you think she'll surpass
Rudolf?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
I want to skip straight to the finals! I
wonder
which of them is stronger?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр B

text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your award, Narita
Brian!
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text: Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
U-Um... So who would you most like to
convey
your feelings to about receiving
this award?
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text: Well, that'd have to be...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Every single racer here today.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I've only just finished my classic year.
Senior races
are coming next.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
That means even if you call me
Umamusume of
the Year, I still haven't
raced everyone that's here
today. Can
you really call that impressive?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I don't think so. It's just a temporary
title. You
could strip me of the award
and title right now,
and I wouldn't care.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: What?!
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text:
So I'm asking every Umamusume here
today—how
about a battle for the top?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Let's find out which of us really is the
strongest.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: That's all.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
W-Wait a moment, please! We're still
planning
to—
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text: Not me. All I'm planning on is the race.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...What just happened?! Did she just challenge everyone to a race?!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
F-forget about surpassing Rudolf! This is

something totally unprecedented!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр B

text_block_list.text:
Hey, contact the editorial department!
The front
page of tomorrow's paper will
be "Brian's
Unprecedented Challenge!"
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
"Calling the Emperor and all other
racers: Who
will be the one to defeat
Нарита Брайан?"
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
Your announcement caused quite the
stir, Brian.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
After much searching, I finally find
Нарита Брайан
standing outside the venue.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
You're the one who told me to be
honest.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I want to compete more. I want to win.
It's as
simple as that.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
While I'm not sure if she has any idea
what to
expect from here, Нарита Брайан
nevertheless smiles
fearlessly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
